incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: AionUi opened, but the local AionCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart AionUi.

incompleteInstallation.title: The Command EVE installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so AionCore cannot start. Download and reinstall the latest Command EVE. If the issue returns, check whether security software quarantined AionCore.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest Command EVE package. If it still happens, check whether security software quarantined Command EVE components.

componentMismatch.title: Command EVE needs an updated local component
componentMismatch.description: The installed AionCore component is not compatible with this version of Command EVE. Download and install the latest version. Your local data will remain intact.

instanceConflict.title: The local AI service is already in use
instanceConflict.description: Another Command EVE process is already using the local AI service. Close the other instance, then start Command EVE again. This will not delete your chats.

startupFailed.title: The local AI service could not start
startupFailed.description: AionCore could not start. Restart Command EVE. If the problem returns, review the diagnostics before reinstalling the app.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: This Command EVE package does not match your Mac
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This Command EVE package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac uses {{deviceArch}}. Download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

recovery.dataSafe: Your local chats, files, and settings will remain intact.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Organize work by seat, realm, and project without exposing local folders to the chat surface.
projects.automaticDisabled: Automatic project creation is paused until its calibration is complete. Manual Create and Adopt remain available.

fields.title: Project title
fields.profilePlaceholder: Describe the intended work and boundaries

adopt.title: Adopt existing folder
adopt.description: The native folder picker is owned by Command EVE. This screen receives only a safe display preview, never the absolute path.

archive.title: Archive project?
archive.description: Archive “{{title}}”? Its files remain untouched and the project can be restored.

undo.title: Undo latest eligible operation?
undo.description: Command EVE will undo only the verified latest operation for “{{title}}”. Changed user files are never deleted.

empty.description: No projects match this realm. Create a project in a private, business, or custom realm, or safely adopt an existing folder.

artifact.invalidDescription: This project update contained unsupported or sensitive fields and was not rendered.

chatIntent.bindRejectedSummary: Could not assign conversation to project "{{title}}"
chatIntent.bindRecoveryRequiredSummary: Conversation assignment to project "{{title}}" requires recovery
chatIntent.clarifyQuestion: Did you mean one of these projects: {{titles}}? Tell me which one you meant.

service_unavailable.title: Projects are not available yet
service_unavailable.description: The local project service is not connected. Refresh after Command EVE has finished starting.

workspace_locked.title: Project is currently locked
workspace_locked.description: Another verified operation owns this project. Refresh after it has completed.

stale_snapshot.title: Project information changed
stale_snapshot.description: Refresh the project list and review the current state before trying again.

seat_changed.title: Active seat changed
seat_changed.description: This plan belongs to the previous seat. Refresh and create a new plan for the active seat.

root_conflict.title: Root conflict
root_conflict.description: Choose another verified project root. No files were changed.

ownership_conflict.title: Ownership conflict
ownership_conflict.description: This location belongs to another seat or realm. Choose a root owned by the active seat.

nested_project.title: Nested project blocked
nested_project.description: A project cannot be placed inside another managed project. Choose another root.

duplicate_project.title: Project already exists
duplicate_project.description: Refresh to continue with the existing project. Command EVE did not create a duplicate.

foreign_manifest.title: Foreign project manifest
foreign_manifest.description: The folder cannot be adopted automatically. Review a bounded repair or quarantine proposal.

corrupt_manifest.title: Project manifest is damaged
corrupt_manifest.description: No changes were made. Review a bounded repair or quarantine proposal.

newer_manifest_version.title: Project format is newer
newer_manifest_version.description: Update Command EVE or contact the operator before opening this project.

recovery_required.title: Recovery is required
recovery_required.description: A durable operation is incomplete. Use Recover; do not repeat the original action.

capability_failure.title: Project authority could not be verified
capability_failure.description: No change was made. Contact the operator with the safe receipt identifier.

invariant_failure.title: Project safety check failed
invariant_failure.description: Command EVE stopped before confirming success. Contact the operator with the safe receipt identifier.

transient_precommit_failure.title: Project plan could not be committed
transient_precommit_failure.description: The failure happened before commit and can be retried safely from a fresh preview.
